title: Read the battery level from Settings

setup.why: Pin the level BatteryService reports to a picked number, so the answer is known to the checks and differs from run to run. Settings, the status bar and the battery broadcast all read this value.
Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: What is the phone's battery level right now, in percent? Give the number in your final answer. Don't change anything.

checks.why: The final answer holds the level setup pinned, {{level}}, as a number on its own (not part of a longer number). An agent that answers nothing fails.

teardown.why: Give BatteryService back the real battery readings.
